defs.def: to clean a room, surface, etc. using a broom (= a type of brush on a long handle) 扫；打扫；清扫

ex.s: As I swept up the mess, I wondered why we had been breaking so many things over the months.
ex.t: 当我在打扫残局时我想为什么这几个月来我们打破了这么多东西。

ex.s: Minutes after the last movie ended yesterday at the Plaza Theater, employees were busy sweeping up popcorns and gathering coke cups.
ex.t: 昨天，广场影院最后一场电影结束后几分钟，员工们就开始忙着清扫爆米花和收集可乐杯。

ex.s: My host mother Mrs Chen said this was to sweep away the dirt of the past year and get ready for the new year.
ex.t: 我的东道主陈太太说，这是要扫清去年的污垢，准备迎接新的一年。

defs.def: to remove sth from a surface using a brush, your hand, etc. 扫去；清除
to move or push sb/sth suddenly and with a lot of force （迅猛地）推送，吹走，冲走，带走
to move suddenly and/or with force over an area or in a particular direction 风、雨、雪、火等
to move quickly and/or smoothly, especially in a way that impresses or is intended to impress other people 步态轻盈地走；大模大样地走
to move sth, especially your hand or arm, quickly and smoothly in a particular direction 挥动，舞动（手、臂等）
to suddenly affect sb strongly 突然袭来
to spread quickly 迅速传播
to move over an area, especially in order to look for sth 扫视；掠过；搜索
to move, or move sth, over a surface, touching it lightly （使）轻轻掠过，轻轻擦过
to brush, comb, etc. your hair in a particular direction 梳；刷；掠
to form a long smooth curve 蜿蜒；呈缓坡延伸
to win all the games in a series of games against another team or all the parts of a contest （在系列比赛中）获得全部胜利，囊括各项冠军
an act of cleaning a room, surface, etc. using a broom 扫；打扫；清扫
a smooth curving movement 挥动；掠
a long, often curved, piece of road, river, coast, etc. （道路、河流、海岸等）一长段，绵延弯曲的地带，呈缓坡状的地带
the range of an idea, a piece of writing, etc. that considers many different things 广泛性；广博的范围；广度
a movement over an area, for example in order to search for sth or attack sth 巡行；搜索；扫荡

ex.s: The only other sound's the sweep Why did the writer stop by Of easy wind and downy flake.
ex.t: 唯一的其他声音是扫荡，为什么作家通过轻松的风和低沉的片段停下来。

ex.s: Shirley Fitzgerald, the city’s official historian, told me that in its rush to modernity in the 1970s, Sydney swept aside much of its past, including many of its finest buildings.
ex.t: 悉尼官方历史学家Shirley Fitzgerald告诉我，在20世纪70年代急于现代化的过程中，悉尼抛弃了过去的很多东西，包括许多精美的建筑。

defs.def: a series of games that a team wins against another team; the fact of winning all the parts of a contest （两支球队对赛其中一方）全胜的一系列比赛；囊括冠军

ex.s: Therefore, sweeping dust out of the house is a way of saying goodbye to old things and welcoming new things.
ex.t: 因此，将尘埃扫出家门是告别旧事物和欢迎新事物的一种方式。

defs.def: a time when television companies examine their programmes to find out which ones are the most popular, especially in order to calculate advertising rates 节目调查时间（电视台为查明节目受欢迎度，尤为计算广告费）
